AccountHelp.title: Sign in without creating an account
AccountHelp.intro: You don’t create a password. You sign in with a one-time code (OTP).

steps.one: Enter your email and press Next.
steps.two: Check your inbox for the 6-digit OTP code.
steps.three: Enter the code correctly. The app confirms it on the server.
steps.four: You are redirected and your role is assigned automatically if your email was pre-approved by admins.

AccountHelp.rolePersistence: If your email is flagged with a role, you keep that role as long as it stays assigned.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Can read and write all data.

member.label: Member
member.description: Can read specific non-public data on top of the public data. Cannot write data.

anon.label: Anon (no role)
anon.description: Can read only public data. Cannot write data.

password.question: Do I ever need a password?
password.answer: No. We use passwordless sign-in. Your email + OTP is enough.

role.question: What if I should have a role but I don’t get it after sign-in?
role.answer: Contact an admin so they can pre-assign your role to your email.
